upstream.description: Implement a ChatGPT-like LLM in PyTorch from scratch, step by step

classification.analysis: The official companion code repository for Sebastian Raschka's book 'Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)', walking through implementing, pretraining, and finetuning a GPT-like LLM in PyTorch chapter by chapter (attention mechanisms, KV cache, GQA, LoRA finetuning, instruction tuning). It's organized as Jupyter notebooks plus supporting Python scripts per chapter and appendix, designed to run on a laptop without specialized hardware. Aimed at developers/ML learners who want hands-on understanding of LLM internals rather than a production training framework; extremely popular (100k+ stars) and actively maintained alongside a video course and a sequel book on reasoning models.

use_cases.title: Learn how GPT-style LLMs are built layer by layer
Reference PyTorch code for pretraining a small LLM
Study LoRA finetuning and instruction-tuning examples
